correctness.rationale: For two size-n multisets a shared size-three deletion output exists iff the coordinatewise minimum sums to at least three. Heavy words inject into q coordinates; any two light words have overlap at least 2n-2q>=4; no light words exist for n>2q. Explicit pure plus light constructions achieve both bounds, and even/odd witness formulas prove sharpness at n=q+1. Finite checker verifies q<=8 constructions and q<=5 pair classes but is not used as an unbounded proof.

value.rationale: The three-survivor regime is a core coding-theoretic extremum for permutation channels. The complete q-parameter exact answer, both sharp thresholds, and explicit optimal codes give a structural explanation and markedly strengthen the known general upper bound. This is neither a finite table recalculation nor an arbitrary fixed-q specialization.
